card.name: Comma between confidence interval bounds
card.fires_on: The comma or "to" between the lower and upper bounds of a 95% confidence interval, right after the lower number, as in "95% CI: 1.09, 2.59". Weaker on a decimal point inside a dose number.

modes.label: Confidence interval separator
modes.description: The comma or "to" after the lower bound of a confidence interval that follows an HR or risk ratio.

modes.label: Decimal point in dose
modes.description: A decimal point inside a dose number in a dosing limit, a weaker and rarer case.
modes.example: Vardenafil: no more than 2<<.>>5 mg every 72 hours.

card.writes: It suppresses digit tokens like 0, 1 and 2, so the next token is less likely to be a digit or underscore, though this is not a clean fit.
card.plain: It marks the spot between the two ends of a confidence interval, just before the upper number.
